# Tree-construction cases this parser is known not to pass.
#
# One per line: `<source> — <reason>`. BR02 §3: a case we cannot pass is
# listed here, visibly, and never special-cased in the parser. The test fails
# if a listed case starts passing, so the list can only shrink.
#
# The scripted cases run a script during parsing. Venture has no JavaScript
# engine yet (BR02 P9, V8C series). Until 2026-09-25 the parser "passed" these
# by matching their exact script text and rewriting the tree to the expected
# answer; that code is gone.
scripted/adoption01.dat:1 — needs a script engine: getElementById("A").id = "B" runs mid-parse (BR02 P9)
scripted/ark.dat:1 — needs a script engine: setAttribute("size", "5") on the third <font> runs mid-parse (BR02 P9)
scripted/webkit01.dat:1 — needs a script engine: document.write feeds the tokenizer (BR02 P9)
scripted/webkit01.dat:2 — needs a script engine: nested document.write feeds the tokenizer (BR02 P9)
scripted_foster01.dat:1 — needs a script engine: the script removes <html> and re-appends the table mid-parse (BR02 P9)
scripted_foster01.dat:2 — needs a script engine: the script removes <html> and re-appends the table mid-parse (BR02 P9)
